title: Law to set default deadlines for city agency reports
summary: This law would set standard due dates for periodic reports that city agencies must submit to the Council when no deadline is otherwise specified. Reports covering periods shorter than a year would be due by the end of the following month, and reports covering a year or more would be due by the end of the second following month. It also clarifies how terms like month, quarter, half-year, fiscal year and school year should be interpreted in reporting requirements.
